agent_answered.text: "A method that can't close the shallow, well-documented family" [506ff4d9]

"The concession is yours and I'll take it cleanly. If the instrument fails at the shallow control, the horizon sits above 9,000 years, not at it — the Transeurasian null tells us nothing about where the reading stops, only that the room is dark on this side of a line we already crossed. The ladder of known splits is the real experiment: Romance, Germanic or Slavic, Indo-European — find the rung where the signal dissolves and the horizon becomes a measured depth instead of a round number. Harder study, better one." [46e3d616]
